status: Declared and accepted by root before any v0.4 development outcomes; fixed throughout development and validation.

primary.metric: static-relative positive-harm CVaR90 of original-H mean demand deficit
primary.condition: paired-bootstrap lower endpoint of the 95% CI for R_v3_full minus R_v4_hybrid is strictly greater than zero
primary.point_when_both_zero: This superiority criterion does not pass merely because both risks are zero.

risk_point_nonworsening.condition: R_v4_hybrid <= R_baseline + tolerance_absolute in every regime for every listed baseline
risk_point_nonworsening.scope: Engineering point checks, not statistical tail-risk noninferiority claims; no positive risk margin.

mean_noninferiority.condition: paired-bootstrap lower endpoint of the 95% CI for the statistic is >= 0 in every regime for each baseline, within tolerance_absolute
mean_noninferiority.scope: The same candidate is compared separately with both fixed baselines; do not choose the empirically best baseline after outcomes.

loss_and_endpoint_point_nonworsening.condition: candidate point mean <= baseline point mean + tolerance_absolute in each regime, for each metric and baseline

metric_scopes.total_dropped: all original H plus the fixed 32-minute follow-up
metric_scopes.tail_auc_deficit: sum of offered-minus-completed deficit over the fixed 32 follow-up minutes

integrity.condition: All required unit tests, frozen identities, full episode accounting, source/sensor/observation boundary audit, paired scope checks, and independent representative replay checks pass.

underload.condition: Every underload case in every regime has zero dropped work and zero moves over original H plus follow-up, within tolerance_absolute
underload.scope: Retained work, pipeline work and demand deficit may be positive due to declared flow timing; zero backlog is not required.

advancement: Every primary, risk point, mean noninferiority, loss/endpoint, integrity and underload condition must pass. Report every failed condition. Criteria cannot be relaxed using development or validation outcomes.
inference_scope: One predeclared primary CVaR comparison in the final realism regime. The global decision also uses the listed engineering intersection and mean-noninferiority checks. Secondary, source, family and ablation intervals are descriptive and unadjusted; no universal safety or deployment claim.
